name: Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT)
description: A computer-based test of quantitative, verbal and data-insights skills, accepted by business schools in India and abroad for MBA and PGDM admission. Scores stay valid for five years.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any discipline; some schools also ask for work experience.
syllabus: Quantitative Reasoning (problem solving), Verbal Reasoning (reading comprehension and critical reasoning) and Data Insights (data sufficiency, tables, graphics and multi-source reasoning).

name: Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA)
conducting_body: Directorate of Technical Education, Tamil Nadu
description: Online counselling for B.E. and B.Tech seats in Tamil Nadu's engineering colleges. Seats are allotted on Class 12 marks, so there is no separate entrance test.
eligibility: Passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics; Tamil Nadu rules on nativity and category apply.
syllabus: No entrance syllabus: the rank list is built from Class 12 marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.

name: COMEDK UGET
description: Computer-based entrance test for B.E. and B.Tech seats in the private engineering colleges of Karnataka that belong to the COMEDK consortium.
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, with the minimum marks COMEDK sets each year.
syllabus: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics of the Class 11 and 12 syllabus.

name: MHT CET
conducting_body: State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra
description: Maharashtra's entrance test for B.E. and B.Tech admission, with separate groups for the engineering and pharmacy streams.
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics plus Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology or a technical subject, with the minimum marks the CET Cell sets.
syllabus: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (PCM group), drawn from the Class 11 and 12 syllabus with weight on Class 12.
